Asia/Riyadh is UTC+3 in 1960.  
US/Hawaii is UTC-10:30 in 1960 (Hawaiian Standard Time).  
Time difference = -10:30 - 3 = -13:30.  

4:00 - 13:30 = (4:00 - 13:30) = -9:30 = 24:00 - 9:30 = 14:30 previous day.  
November 6, 1960 minus 1 day → November 5, 1960, 14:30.
